Depends on how many tokens and packages you already have (minutes, if you buy the items from other players)

The {wiki:Crystal Warlord Outfits|Crystal Warlord Outfits} are obtained with three gnomish vouchers. The base outfit and the first addon are swapped for {item:Major Crystalline Token|Major} and {item:Minor Crystalline Token|Minor Crystalline Tokens} with the NPC {npc:Gnomally}, in Gnomegate; the second addon drops, with low probability, from {item:Gnomish Supply Package|Gnomish Supply Packages}. All these items come from the {wiki:Bigfoot's Burden Quest} or can be bought from other players.
No minimum level, but the **recommended level is 120** (for the Bigfoot's Burden Quest missions).
Access to the {wiki:GCTS|Gnomish Crystal Teleport System} (level 80 and authorisation from {npc:Xelvar}, in Kazordoon) to reach Gnomegate.
To get the tokens and Gnomish Supply Packages yourself you need the {wiki:Bigfoot's Burden Quest}. If you buy the items from other players, the effect is the same.
for the Gnomish Voucher Type CB (base outfit)
for the Gnomish Voucher Type CA1 (addon 1)
small chance of giving the Gnomish Voucher Type CA2 (addon 2)
one to enter and one to leave the GCTS (150 gp each)
Addon 1 (cape and mask) and addon 2 (shield and club)
You do not have to get anything yourself: buying the tokens, the packages or the vouchers themselves from other players has the same effect.
The dangers are those of the creatures in the {wiki:Bigfoot's Burden Quest}, if you are the one earning the tokens.
Collect **20 {item:Major Crystalline Token|Major Crystalline Tokens}** with the {wiki:Bigfoot's Burden Quest} missions (or buy them from other players).

Gnomegate can only be reached through the {wiki:GCTS|Gnomish Crystal Teleport System} (GCTS), which requires **level 80**, authorisation from {npc:Xelvar} (it is the start of the {wiki:Bigfoot's Burden Quest}: {key:hi}, {key:adventures}, {key:recruiting}, {key:partners}, {key:gnomes}, {key:help}, {key:join}) and a {item:Teleport Crystal} (150 gp) for each entry and exit. From **Kazordoon**: the teleport is **east** of {npc:Xelvar}, near the north blesser ({coord:32628,31863,11}). There are also GCTS teleports in Thais (Ancient Temple), Edron (sewers), Darashia (mountain to the northwest), Liberty Bay (mountains to the southeast) and Svargrond (hole next to the west exit). You appear in the GCTS hub, above Gnomegate; go down to Gnomegate and head to the **north** part, where {npc:Gnomally} is.
Go to **Gnomegate** and talk to the NPC {npc:Gnomally} ({key:hi}, {key:trade}). Exchange the 20 Major Crystalline Tokens for a {item:Gnomish Voucher Type CB}.
Use the {item:Gnomish Voucher Type CB} to unlock the outfit.
Collect **70 {item:Minor Crystalline Token|Minor Crystalline Tokens}** with the Bigfoot's Burden Quest (or buy them).

If you have already left Gnomegate, go back there through the GCTS (as in the step “Get to Gnomegate”). Exchange the 70 Minor Crystalline Tokens with the NPC {npc:Gnomally} for a {item:Gnomish Voucher Type CA1}.
Use the {item:Gnomish Voucher Type CA1} to receive the first addon.

To leave, go up from Gnomegate to the GCTS hub and step into the teleport of the city you want to go to (Kazordoon, Thais, Edron, Darashia, Liberty Bay or Svargrond). You use up another {item:Teleport Crystal}, so always bring at least two (you can buy them from {npc:Gnomette}, in the GCTS hub, or from {npc:Xelvar}).

Use {item:Gnomish Supply Package|Gnomish Supply Packages} (from the Bigfoot's Burden Quest). Each one has a **small** chance of containing a {item:Gnomish Voucher Type CA2}. Repeat until you get it (or buy the voucher from another player).
Use the {item:Gnomish Voucher Type CA2} to receive the second addon.
